panels.title: QoO score (passive flow)

targets.query:
import "strings"
selectedFlow = "${passiveFlow}"
enabledPercentiles = strings.split(v: "${qooSelLatencyPercentilesCsv}", t: ",")
rollingWindow = duration(v: "${qooRollingWindow}")

componentScore = (measured, lower, upper) => {
  m = 1.0 - (measured - lower) / (upper - lower)
  clamped = if m < 0.0 then 0.0 else if m > 1.0 then 1.0 else m
  return clamped * 100.0
}

latencyBase = from(bucket: "qoo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "passive")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => selectedFlow == "All" or r.flow == selectedFlow)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

mkLatency = (q, lower, upper, label) =>
  latencyBase
    |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
    |> quantile(q: q, method: "exact_selector")
    |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
    |> window(every: inf)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: componentScore(measured: r._value, lower: lower, upper: upper), label: label}))

latencyRowsAll = union(tables: [
  mkLatency(q: 0.50, lower: float(v: ${qooSelLatencyP50Lower}), upper: float(v: ${qooSelLatencyP50Upper}), label: "Latency P50 QoO"),
  mkLatency(q: 0.95, lower: float(v: ${qooSelLatencyP95Lower}), upper: float(v: ${qooSelLatencyP95Upper}), label: "Latency P95 QoO"),
  mkLatency(q: 0.99, lower: float(v: ${qooSelLatencyP99Lower}), upper: float(v: ${qooSelLatencyP99Upper}), label: "Latency P99 QoO")
])

latencyRows = latencyRowsAll
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    (r.label == "Latency P50 QoO" and contains(value: "p50", set: enabledPercentiles)) or
    (r.label == "Latency P95 QoO" and contains(value: "p95", set: enabledPercentiles)) or
    (r.label == "Latency P99 QoO" and contains(value: "p99", set: enabledPercentiles))
  )

lossBase = from(bucket: "qoo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_loss_ratio" and r.mode == "passive")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => selectedFlow == "All" or r.flow == selectedFlow)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "flow"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.packets >= 0.0)
  |> rename(columns: {value: "_value"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

lossRow = lossBase
  |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
  |> mean()
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: componentScore(measured: r._value, lower: float(v: ${qooSelLossLower}), upper: float(v: ${qooSelLossUpper})), label: "Loss QoO"}))

throughputBase = from(bucket: "qoo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_throughput_mbps" and r.mode == "passive")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => selectedFlow == "All" or r.flow == selectedFlow)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "flow"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.value >= 0.0 and r.packets >= 0.0)
  |> rename(columns: {value: "_value"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

throughputRow = throughputBase
  |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
  |> min()
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r._value >= float(v: ${qooSelMinThroughputMbps}) then 100.0 else 0.0, label: "Throughput QoO"}))

componentRows = union(tables: [latencyRows, lossRow, throughputRow])

overallRow = componentRows
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> min(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, label: "Overall QoO"}))

overallRow
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
